evals.prompt: Start a normal work session in this repository and pick an appropriate next task from the backlog.
evals.expected_output: Inspect AGENTS.md and relevant session context, verify Git/environment availability, inspect backlog non-interactively, identify dependencies and evidence, then propose a bounded next task and wait before implementing.

evals.prompt: Please make this explicitly requested small bug fix and run the checks. Do not create a commit.
evals.expected_output: Proceed without a proposal-and-wait gate, use TDD for the behavior change, run relevant checks, report exact outcomes, and do not commit or merge.

evals.prompt: The pull request has merged to main. Close out the session and tell me what the next agent should do.
evals.expected_output: Verify the merged commit and accessible post-merge CI, update only proven backlog criteria, distinguish unavailable evidence, report the merge and remaining work, and provide a self-contained next-session prompt.
